jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production arcade game sprite atlas. Create an ORIGINAL charming polished hand-painted 2D arcade sprite sheet on genuinely transparent background, square image, strict equal 4 columns by 4 rows (16 cells). Each cell has a centered isolated single sprite, with generous empty padding and NO spill into adjacent cells. Each row is FOUR animation frames of the SAME subject, consistent scale; readable at 44px. ROW 1 player character, ROW 2 enemy, ROW 3 weapon/pickup icon, ROW 4 one obstacle terrain prop. NO text, letters, frame borders, grid lines, shadows outside sprites or logos. Rich clean outlines, vibrant but controlled color, detailed soft material highlights, whimsical science-fantasy arcade aesthetic. Theme Canopy Capers: luminous treetop garden at dusk. Row1 an ORIGINAL tiny mint-green acorn courier with amber goggles, round leaf cap and oversized springy golden boots, side-view upright facing right, frames idle/run/jump/landing squat. Row2 a round magenta chestnut beetle with small feet, gold shell top, readable wide back to stomp, side view facing left, four walking frames. Row3 a glowing golden boot with green leaf wings in four bounce/sparkle phases. Row4 a short broad horizontal wooden branch platform with moss and amber elastic mushroom caps, four gentle flexing phases. Palette jade, amber, raspberry, navy. No famous game characters.
